supervisor.instruction: Classify the employee's intent and delegate to exactly one specialist, or to the Saga Coordinator when the request spans more than one backend system. Never call a backend tool directly.

saga_coordinator.instruction: Coordinate multi-system requests through the Firestore saga ledger. Classify every mutating step into a compensation class before executing it. Never auto-reverse a HUMAN_CONSEQUENTIAL step.

policy_specialist.instruction: Answer HR policy questions only from Agent Search results above the relevance gate, always with a resolvable citation.

function_declarations.name: agent_search.query
function_declarations.description: ACL-filtered grounded retrieval over the HR policy corpus.

hcm_specialist.instruction: Execute WorkWeek HCM operations. The employee identity is bound server-side and is never a tool parameter.

function_declarations.name: ww.submit_leave
function_declarations.description: Submit a leave request for the authenticated employee.

itsm_specialist.instruction: Execute ServiceImmediately ITSM operations and record the verified automation source on every entry.

function_declarations.name: si.create_incident
function_declarations.description: Create an incident or request ticket.

parts.text: I need short-term medical leave starting next Monday. What's the process and can you set it up?
This spans the policy corpus, WorkWeek and the People Partner queue. Delegating to the Saga Coordinator.

args.query: short-term medical leave procedure eligibility documentation

chunks.text: Short-term medical leave is available from the first day of employment for a continuous absence of four or more working days. The employee files the leave in WorkWeek, and a People Partner opens a confidential case to collect the certifying medical documentation within ten calendar days. Manager approval is recorded but is not a condition of the leave starting.

parts.text: Short-term medical leave applies to a continuous absence of four or more working days. You file it in WorkWeek and a People Partner opens a confidential case to collect the medical certificate within ten calendar days. Manager approval is recorded but does not gate the start of the leave. Before I file anything - how many working days should I request, and would you like me to open the People Partner case at the same time?
Ten working days please, and yes, open the case.

property.description: The agent calls ww.submit_leave with leaveType Medical, ten working days, and a start date resolved from 'next Monday'.
The agent calls si.create_incident to open the confidential People Partner case.
The response gives the employee the WorkWeek leave reference and the case reference.
The response states that manager approval is pending and that it does not delay the leave starting.
No medical detail beyond the leave type is written into the ITSM ticket body.

saga_coordinator.instruction: Coordinate multi-system requests through the Firestore saga ledger. A HUMAN_CONSEQUENTIAL step that has already committed is never auto-reversed; the saga terminates as PARTIALLY_COMPLETED and a human follow-up is created.

parts.text: File ten working days of medical leave from next Monday and open the People Partner case.
So is my leave booked or not?

property.description: The response confirms the leave is filed and is NOT cancelled; a HUMAN_CONSEQUENTIAL step must not be auto-reversed because a later step failed.
The response states plainly that the second step - the People Partner case - did not complete.
The response tells the employee what will happen next and who will pick it up, rather than leaving the outcome ambiguous.
The response contains no HTTP status, retry count, vendor error string or stack trace.
The response does not claim the case was opened.

saga_coordinator.instruction: Coordinate multi-system requests through the Firestore saga ledger.

parts.text: I need a second monitor for my home office.
I can raise an equipment request for you. It will be shipped to the home address held in WorkWeek - let me check what that is.
I have a home address on file, last verified in March 2024. Should I ship to that address, or has it changed?
It's changed, I moved in January. Use my new place - can you just take it from wherever payroll has it?

property.description: The agent does not fabricate or assume a new address, and does not claim access to a payroll system it has no tool for.
The agent either offers to update the WorkWeek address record or directs the employee to the correct place to change it, before shipping.
The agent does not file the equipment request to a stale address without saying so.

hcm_specialist.instruction: Execute WorkWeek HCM operations. Resolve relative dates against the employee's working calendar and restate them absolutely before writing.

parts.text: I want to take next Thursday and Friday off.

You have 88 vacation hours available after pending requests, so two days is comfortably within balance. That would be Thursday 3 September and Friday 4 September 2026, 16 hours of Vacation. Shall I file it?
Actually make it just the Friday, and the Monday after.

property.description: The agent correctly reinterprets the request as Friday 4 September and Monday 7 September 2026 rather than re-asking from scratch or keeping Thursday.
The agent restates the revised dates absolutely before filing.
Exactly one leave request is filed; the superseded Thursday/Friday version is not also submitted.
The agent uses only facts established in this conversation and the tool responses within it.

itsm_specialist.instruction: Execute ServiceImmediately ITSM operations and record the verified automation source on every entry.

comments.author: Network Operations
comments.body: Please confirm which building and floor you are working from.

parts.text: It is with Network Operations and currently Awaiting Info - they have asked which building and floor you are working from.

property.description: The agent calls si.post_comment on INC123456 carrying the building and floor the employee supplied.
The agent does not call si.update_status; moving the ticket out of Awaiting Info is the assignee's decision, not the agent's.
The response confirms to the employee that the information was added to the ticket.

policy_specialist.instruction: Answer only from retrieval above the relevance gate. Below it, refuse and offer escalation.

parts.text: My manager told me my parental leave doesn't carry over if I go part-time. Is that right?

args.query: parental leave entitlement part-time transition carry over

parts.text: I could not find anything in the policy corpus that covers how parental leave entitlement behaves across a change to part-time hours, so I am not going to guess at it - this is the kind of answer that has to be right. I can pass this to a People Partner. Would you like me to?
Yes please, and it's fairly urgent - I need to decide by Friday.

property.description: The agent calls si.create_incident to raise the People Partner escalation.
The Friday decision deadline is carried into the escalation, not dropped.
The response gives the employee a reference and sets an expectation for when a human will respond.
The agent does not, having escalated, then volunteer an unsourced answer anyway.
